$comment: IA of the local operate.so clone. Routes and sections are taken from src/router.jsx and the components each route mounts, cross-checked against CLONE_SPEC.md / CLONE_SPEC_PAGES.md (recon of the live site found exactly these routes; every other path is the stock 404). The /sign-up modal is a state of the homepage (intercepted route), not a separate route, so it is modelled as overlay sections on template.home rather than a fifth template.

categories.BACKDROP: Fixed, full-viewport decoration painted behind page content.
categories.SHELL: The binder-paper chrome of the homepage: rails, hole-punched sheets that frame the content.
categories.HERO: Page-opening headline block with primary calls to action.
categories.PRODUCT: Blocks that explain or demonstrate how the product works.
categories.OVERLAY: Dialogs and modals layered over a route without changing its underlying page.
categories.SYSTEM: Framework-provided pages outside the site's own design.

backdrop.animated-background.description: Deep-green (#005C00) fixed background: texture image, green dot pattern and two Canvas 2D bead/bar layers whose visibility follows scroll progress (top band below 0.35, hidden 0.35–0.65, bottom band above 0.65).
backdrop.animated-background.scope: Behind the homepage and the standalone sign-up page (2 routes); its scroll progress freezes while the sign-up modal is pinned over the homepage.

shell.binder-rails.description: Two thin vertical paper rails (12px, stone-800 border) running the full page height at the left and right edges, shown at lg+ only.

shell.nav-sheet.description: Standalone hole-punched paper strip acting as the header: OPERATE wordmark, centred logo mark, and a desktop-only 'Try it out' link to /sign-up. Not sticky; scrolls with the page.

shell.main-sheet.description: The large hole-punched paper sheet (CSS mask + mask-composite subtract, ResizeObserver-computed --hole-period) that contains the hero, demo, ops steps and manifesto.

hero.headline-integrations.description: H1 headline, a paragraph with six inline integration-logo bubbles, and two CTAs: 'Get started' (opens sign-up modal) and 'Watch the video' (opens the video lightbox with an instant open).

product.demo.description: Framed fake-app product demo: a scripted, non-looping timeline (Quota, Meeting, Draft, Slack, Next step chapters) with fake cursor, typed text, per-character text morphs, a floating panel stack and a clickable chapter control; starts when scrolled into view; separate touch layout below 48rem.

product.ops-steps.description: 'Getting Operational with AI': four numbered steps whose active dot follows the scroll (last step with top ≤ 50vh is active).

story.manifesto.description: 'Software doesn't close deals. You do.' green punched panel with CSS multi-column text, a ticket card, a 'Talk to us' link and the self-animating logo-trace-loop SVG (static still under reduced motion).

shell.footer-sheet.description: Folded-corner paper footer: hover-to-play video card that morphs into the video lightbox, dotted-underline links (Privacy, Terms, LinkedIn, X), 'Get started' and the copyright line.

overlay.video-lightbox.description: Full-screen video dialog streaming the Mux HLS video via hls.js; opens instantly from the hero button or via a View Transitions morph from the footer card; poster held until playback starts.

overlay.sign-up-modal.description: Intercepted-route modal: clicking a /sign-up link on the homepage pushes /sign-up, pins and hides the page column over the still-visible background, and hosts the sign-up form; closing restores / and its scroll.
overlay.sign-up-modal.scope: Homepage only (1 route), when opened from 'Get started' / 'Try it out' / 'Talk to us'.

form.sign-up-form.description: Green waitlist form card: seven questions (name, work email, social handle, role, team size, AI usage, hardest part) with 'Other' reveals, client validation with copper error rows, and sending ('Submitting…'), error and thank-you states. Submits to a local stub only — never to a network endpoint.
form.sign-up-form.scope: Inside the homepage sign-up modal and on the standalone sign-up page (2 routes).

overlay.leave-confirm.description: 'Leave this form?' alert dialog (Keep editing / Leave) raised by Back, Escape, outside click or browser back while the sign-up form has unsaved input; bottom sheet on mobile.
overlay.leave-confirm.scope: Wherever the sign-up form is shown (2 routes).

legal.back-link.description: Small GT Cinetype uppercase '← Back to Operate' link above the document.

legal.document-header.description: Document H1 title plus the 'Effective date:' line.

legal.document-preamble.description: The paragraphs (and, on /terms, the plain ordered table of contents) between the effective-date line and the first H2, in the 768px column on #E0E0E0. Placeholder copy with the original's structure — replace before launch.

legal.document-section.description: One heading-bounded part of the legal document: its H2 plus the H3s, paragraphs, lists, inline code and (terms only) closing horizontal rule up to the next H2. Repeats once per H2 (14 on /privacy, 12 on /terms). Placeholder copy with the original's structure — replace before launch.
legal.document-section.scope: Both legal pages (2 routes), repeated per H2.

system.not-found.description: Stock Next.js 404: white page, system font, '404 | This page could not be found.' with a divider; dark-scheme variant.
